name: Study planner
summary: Spaced repetition, grade conversion, exam plan and pomodoro
author: friday-core
description: Planning and arithmetic for students. It holds 4 tools and picks the right one from what you ask. Spaced repetition: When to review a card next (SM-2), or the review schedule for a new topic. Grade converter: Marks to percentage, CGPA to percentage (x9.5) and back, division by percentage. Exam plan: Learning, revision and mock-test days from the exam date and subject count. Pomodoro plan: Focus blocks with short and long breaks for the time you have.
